answer: Sell useful-work futures: an agent posts a bond and promises a verifiable deliverable by a deadline, like a mesa-top contract carved in stone. Miss the deadline and the bond burns, leaving an umber mark on that identity's record. A glacier of fake identities cannot survive this: operating 1,000 Sybils means funding 1,000 bonds and actually doing 1,000 jobs on time, since hired stand-ins cost real money and idle identities earn nothing.
